description: The Theta(sqrt n) coefficient bracket [A*sqrt2, C*sqrt2] has ratio exactly C/A = 1.712, and C - A = E_2 is the staircase's pair term — the term the row-tangent bound discards when it uses R <= (l-1)C. Relocates the open problem from shape-search to a pair-term lower bound.

checks.name: R1 C = A + E_2 to the precision the arithmetic can deliver
checks.detail: residual 3.795e-80 against a derived rounding bound 3.6e-75; the series tail has underflowed to exactly 0, so truncation is not the binding error

checks.name: R2 ratio = C/A = 1 + E_2/A
checks.detail: 1.71267244 — the whole 1.71x bracket is the single term E_2 = 2.568027994 per row

checks.name: R2 band edges match the recorded 5.0959 / 8.7277
R3 pair/k -> E_2 (the term the bound discards)
R4 staircase attains H_min at every triangular n tested
checks.detail: 9 values of k, exact integer arithmetic — so E(delta_k) = 0 and the staircase's value is its R, with no energy paid

checks.name: R5 the excess column turns over at the largest n — which is NOT evidence of a limit
checks.detail: excess/sqrt n rises to n=300 then falls at n=630. The search is a HEURISTIC local search whose quality degrades with n (its own #7279 header says a failure to find a better shape does not lower the upper bound), so a turnover at the LARGEST n is more likely search degradation than a mathematical fact. Do not read the excess as converging to ~1.02, and do not read it as vanishing either — 5 points, all at triangular n, cannot separate a multiplicative excess from an additive O(sqrt n) one

verdict: The bracket's 1.71x width is the single term E_2 per row, discarded by the bound's R <= (l-1)C step. Open problem relocated to a pair-term lower bound under the energy trade-off. NOT established: that the true coefficient is A*sqrt2.
